purpose: Permanent browser behavior regression for the observed React-PDF text-layer lifecycle failure. Pixel geometry requires a real browser; the Node PDF extraction integration alone cannot cover it.

cases.name: PDF text layers survive reader state updates

input.source: Generated selectable five-page fictional scholarship guidelines PDF
actions: Wait for PDF canvas pages and text layers to finish rendering
Select an evidence finding and allow resulting reader state updates
Wait through at least one additional render cycle
Select a multiline passage and inspect its finding highlight

cases.observedDefect: All five canvases rendered while text layers had zero children and evidence highlights stayed empty. An inline onRenderTextLayerSuccess callback changed identity after its own setRenderVersion update, restarting the React-PDF text-layer effect.
cases.verificationRequirement: Parent agent must recheck actual browser text-layer content and highlights after the stable callback fix. This vector does not itself claim that browser verification passed.
